map.织缩率为什么影响克重？: Why does the shrink rate affect weight?
map.织缩是纱线在织物中屈曲导致的长度损失，织缩越大成品越长、同重下克重略增；须按组织: Weave shrink is the length loss from yarn crimp in the fabric; larger shrink makes the finished cloth longer, slightly raising weight at the same mass; it must be measured per weave (plain / twill).
